bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
name=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
docker inspect "$name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 61
status="$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Status}}' "$name")"
logs="$(docker logs --tail 100 "$name" 2>&1 || true)"
if printf '%s\n' "$logs" | grep -q '^CREATOR_DM_POLL_READY=PASS$'; then exit 0; fi
if printf '%s\n' "$logs" | grep -Eqi 'password authentication failed|28P01'; then exit 80; fi
if printf '%s\n' "$logs" | grep -Eqi 'ENOTFOUND|EAI_AGAIN|ECONNREFUSED|ETIMEDOUT|ENETUNREACH|EHOSTUNREACH'; then exit 81; fi
if printf '%s\n' "$logs" | grep -q 'CREATOR_POLL_DB_PASSWORD_FILE_INVALID'; then exit 82; fi
if printf '%s\n' "$logs" | grep -q 'CREATOR_POLL_INTERNAL_DB_CONFIG_INVALID'; then exit 83; fi
if printf '%s\n' "$logs" | grep -q 'CREATOR_POLL_PRIVATE_SECRET_MOUNT_REQUIRED'; then exit 84; fi
if printf '%s\n' "$logs" | grep -q 'CREATOR_POLL_EXISTING_WEBHOOK_MUST_NOT_BE_REPLACED'; then exit 85; fi
if printf '%s\n' "$logs" | grep -Eqi 'SQLSTATE|relation .* does not exist|permission denied for (table|schema|database)'; then exit 86; fi
if printf '%s\n' "$logs" | grep -Eqi 'Cannot find (module|package)|ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND'; then exit 87; fi
if printf '%s\n' "$logs" | grep -Eqi 'invalid secret file|ENOENT|EACCES'; then exit 88; fi
if printf '%s\n' "$logs" | grep -q 'CREATOR_POLL_RUNTIME_FAILED'; then exit 89; fi
if test "$status" = restarting;then exit 90; fi
exit 91
